But the path forward to creating the necessary local network of CO pipelines to deliver CO to the T-RICH hub is clear and 2 2 practical. Peoples Gas, a Florida natural gas pipeline distribution company, operates natural gas delivery pipelines in the immediate vicinity and throughout the mid-Florida region. They have the capacity and expertise to build CO pipelines from those natural gas customers to the proposed T-RICH hub along some 2 of the same rights of way they already own for natural gas delivery to its customers. In their project support letter written in July 2023, Peoples Gas wrote “Peoples Gas System’s infrastructure is located near the proposed carbon capture and storage transportation hub facilities and is well positioned to support the development and advancements of this technology for the state.” There is also the strong possibility of running a new CO pipeline along ammonia pipelines and main power lines from the port out to 2 consumers in the central part of the state. The entrance to the Pendola Point area of Port Tampa Bay, on which T-RICH will be situated, is directly off U.S. 41, an industrial road which numerous large commercial trucks traverse on a daily basis going into and out of 13 https://pvnpms.phmsa.dot.gov/PublicViewer/ Page31 of158 T-RICH Pre-FEED Report – Public Version the port complex. Trucks carrying CO from the central part of the state can travel west into the Tampa 2 Bay region on I-4 which begins on the east coast of Florida near Daytona Beach and travels through Orlando, Florida’s third most-populous metropolitan region after Tampa-St. Petersburg-Clearwater. From there, they would travel south on U.S. 41 directly to T-RICH. CO trucks coming from the west, such as 2 Pinellas County, would travel east on I-275 and I-4, again heading south on U.S. 41 to reach T-RICH. And CO trucks heading north on I-75 from south Florida (I-75 begins in Miami), would take the exit for 2 Gibsonton Drive, a 4-lane road through a sparsely populated area, in order to reach U.S. 41 northbound and ultimately T-RICH.
